title: serratula lanceolata
intro: Serratula lanceolata, commonly known as Lance-leaf Milk Thistle, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It is a perennial herb native to Europe and Western Asia, valued for its medicinal properties and health benefits. The plant is used to treat various health issues, including liver and gallbladder problems, due to its therapeutic actions of antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and hepatoprotective properties. The bioactive constituents of Serratula lanceolata include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal value.
